integrity: Self-contained proof and exhaustive corroboration; no assertion of independent validation or complete historical priority.
scientific_limitations: The count is for 2 x 2 matrices over finite commutative chain rings, with commuting-Jordan corollary only for two equal blocks. It does not classify conjugacy orbits, unequal blocks, or general matrices. Historical priority remains provisional; a highly relevant 1982 Drazin-index paper was only partially accessible.
title: Cubic-nilpotent centralizers: a valuation plateau over finite chain rings
